verdict.rationale: Highnote is a card issuing, payment processing and ledger platform-as-a-service, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools. Plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. Its 'agentic commerce' material is about issuing cards to external agents, not about the product calling MCP tools, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships an MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
